answer: A joint computation compares new keys against the registry for duplicates without revealing any key in the clear, so a farm cannot probe which of its aliases is already flagged. Each duplicate check costs the farm a fresh alias, because a flagged key is burned the moment the computation runs, while honest keys pass untouched. The nectar of the design is public, the ridge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the zenith of honest work is what finally pays.
